approach.title: Define
approach.summary: Clarify the decision the research must support, then design the questionnaire, sample and coverage plan around it.

approach.title: Pilot
approach.summary: Test the instrument on a small sample, fix ambiguous questions and confirm translation and field logistics before scale-up.

approach.title: Collect
approach.summary: Deploy trained enumerators and coordinators, with daily submissions, back-checks and validation rules to catch bad data early.

approach.title: Analyse
approach.summary: Clean, weight and structure the dataset, then run the statistical and comparative analysis the brief requires.

approach.title: Report
approach.summary: Deliver findings in a format the client can use — executive summary, full report, charts, dashboards or a slide presentation.

faqs.q: Which types of organisations do you work with?
faqs.a: Government departments and public services, private companies and startups, research institutions and think tanks, academic institutions, NGOs and development organisations, political campaigns, market research agencies and multi-sector clients. The method and compliance requirements are adapted to the client and the assignment.

faqs.q: Do you handle qualitative field research?
faqs.a: Yes. We run in-depth interviews, focus group discussions, observational and ethnographic fieldwork, case studies, field verification and mystery-shopping visits alongside structured surveys.

faqs.q: Can we hire you for data collection only?
faqs.a: Yes. The data-collection-only engagement gives you validated raw data from the field, with the questionnaire, sampling plan and quality checks agreed before fieldwork starts.

Personal data is collected with consent and used only for the agreed research purpose. Political and social research follows applicable privacy, election and data protection requirements, with safeguards agreed in the project contract.

faqs.q: Do you deliver raw data or only reports?
faqs.a: Both, depending on the engagement model. Clients who want to run their own analysis can receive validated raw data; clients who want conclusions receive analysis, reports and presentations.

faqs.q: Do you handle survey design and data processing?
faqs.a: Yes. We design questionnaires and sampling plans, programme CAPI, CATI and online instruments, pilot and translate them, then handle data entry, transcription, coding, cleaning and dataset documentation. You can engage us for design only, data processing only or the full study.

faqs.q: Do you run evaluations and third-party monitoring?
faqs.a: Yes. We support M&E frameworks and indicators, baseline, midline and endline studies, process and impact evaluations, and independent third-party monitoring for government, NGO, CSR and donor-funded programmes.
